title: British Airports Authority Office, Heathrow
body: Here on a site adjacent to one of the main runways at London Airport, the strict height controls and massive noise interference anabled one to utilise the unusable – in the form of a narrow, road-boudned strip of land. Roof-parking, helping the sound insulation, enabled multiple spot access to the very centre of this single-floor, open-plan office – the ideal access condiction for burolandschaft.  (CP in The Square Book, p. 43)
